passages.text: Then the people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, the youngest son of Jehoram, king in his place, since the raiders who had come into the camp with the Arabs had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah.
passages.sermon:
The people of Jerusalem chose a new king.
They made Ahaziah king.
Ahaziah was the youngest son of Jehoram.
Jehoram had been king of Judah.
The older sons of Jehoram were dead.
Raiders from Arabia had attacked the camp.
The raiders killed all the older sons.
So Ahaziah, son of Jehoram, became king of Judah.
passages.original: וַיַּמְלִיכוּ֩ יוֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶת־ אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֤וֹ הַקָּטֹן֙ תַּחְתָּ֔יו כִּ֤י כָל־ הָרִאשֹׁנִים֙ הָרַ֣ג הַגְּד֔וּד הַבָּ֥א בָֽעַרְבִ֖ים לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹרָ֖ם מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃פ

passages.text: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem one year. His mother’s name was Athaliah, the granddaughter of Omri.
passages.sermon:
Ahaziah became king of Judah.
Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king.
Ahaziah ruled in Jerusalem.
He ruled for one year.
Ahaziah’s mother was Athaliah.
Athaliah was the granddaughter of Omri.
passages.original: בֶּן־ אַרְבָּעִ֨ים וּשְׁתַּ֤יִם שָׁנָה֙ אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וְשָׁנָ֣ה אַחַ֔ת מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ בַּת־ עָמְרִֽי׃

passages.text: Ahaziah also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother was his counselor in wickedness.
passages.sermon:
Ahaziah was king of Judah.
Ahaziah followed the ways of the house of Ahab.
Ahaziah’s mother was Athaliah.
Athaliah gave Ahaziah advice.
Athaliah advised Ahaziah to do evil.
passages.original: גַּם־ ה֣וּא הָלַ֔ךְ בְּדַרְכֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב כִּ֥י אִמּ֛וֹ הָיְתָ֥ה יֽוֹעַצְתּ֖וֹ לְהַרְשִֽׁיעַ׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, as the house of Ahab had done, for to his destruction they were his counselors after the death of his father.
passages.sermon:
Ahaziah was king of Judah.
Ahaziah did evil in the sight of the LORD.
He acted like the house of Ahab.
The house of Ahab had done evil.
After Ahaziah’s father died, the house of Ahab became his counselors.
These counselors led Ahaziah to destruction.
passages.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּבֵ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב כִּי־ הֵ֜מָּה הָֽיוּ־ ל֣וֹ יֽוֹעֲצִ֗ים אַחֲרֵ֛י מ֥וֹת אָבִ֖יו לְמַשְׁחִ֥ית לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Ahaziah also followed their counsel and went with Joram son of Ahab king of Israel to fight against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead. But the Arameans wounded Joram; so he returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds they had inflicted on him at Ramah when he fought against Hazael king of Aram. Then Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to visit Joram son of Ahab, because Joram had been wounded.
passages.sermon:
Ahaziah was king of Judah.
He listened to the advice of the house of Ahab.
He followed their counsel.
Joram was the son of Ahab.
Joram was king of Israel.
Ahaziah went with Joram.
They went to fight against Hazael.
Hazael was king of Aram.
The battle took place at Ramoth-gilead.
The Arameans wounded Joram.
Joram returned to Jezreel.
He went there to recover from his wounds.
He had been wounded at Ramah.
He was wounded while fighting Hazael king of Aram.
Ahaziah was the son of Jehoram.
Jehoram was also king of Judah.
Ahaziah went down to Jezreel.
He went to visit Joram son of Ahab.
Joram was in Jezreel because he was wounded.
passages.original: גַּ֣ם בַּעֲצָתָם֮ הָלַךְ֒ וַיֵּלֶךְ֩ אֶת־ יְהוֹרָ֨ם בֶּן־ אַחְאָ֜ב מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה עַל־ חֲזָאֵ֥ל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֖ם בְּרָמ֣וֹת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַיַּכּ֥וּ הָֽרַמִּ֖ים אֶת־ יוֹרָֽם׃ וַיָּ֜שָׁב לְהִתְרַפֵּ֣א בְיִזְרְעֶ֗אל כִּ֤י הַמַּכִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכֻּ֣הוּ בָֽרָמָ֔ה בְּהִלָּ֣חֲמ֔וֹ אֶת־ חֲזָהאֵ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וַעֲזַרְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹרָ֜ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה יָרַ֡ד לִרְא֞וֹת אֶת־ יְהוֹרָ֧ם בֶּן־ אַחְאָ֛ב בְּיִזְרְעֶ֖אל כִּי־ חֹלֶ֥ה הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Ahaziah’s downfall came from God when he went to visit Joram. When Ahaziah arrived, he went out with Joram to meet Jehu son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to destroy the house of Ahab.
passages.sermon:
God caused Ahaziah’s downfall.
Ahaziah went to visit Joram.
When Ahaziah arrived, he went out with Joram.
They went to meet Jehu.
Jehu was the son of Nimshi.
The LORD had anointed Jehu.
The LORD chose Jehu to destroy the house of Ahab.
passages.original: וּמֵֽאֱלֹהִ֗ים הָיְתָה֙ תְּבוּסַ֣ת אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ לָב֖וֹא אֶל־ יוֹרָ֑ם וּבְבֹא֗וֹ יָצָ֤א עִם־ יְהוֹרָם֙ אֶל־ יֵה֣וּא בֶן־ נִמְשִׁ֔י אֲשֶׁ֣ר מְשָׁח֣וֹ יְהוָ֔ה לְהַכְרִ֖ית אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית אַחְאָֽב׃

passages.text: So while Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, he found the rulers of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers who were serving Ahaziah, and he killed them.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was carrying out judgment against the house of Ahab.
Jehu found the rulers of Judah.
Jehu also found the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers.
These sons were serving Ahaziah.
Jehu killed the rulers of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֕י כְּהִשָּׁפֵ֥ט יֵה֖וּא עִם־ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וַיִּמְצָא֩ אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה וּבְנֵ֨י אֲחֵ֧י אֲחַזְיָ֛הוּ מְשָׁרְתִ֥ים לַאֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ וַיַּהַרְגֵֽם׃

passages.text: Then Jehu looked for Ahaziah, and Jehu’s soldiers captured him while he was hiding in Samaria. So Ahaziah was brought to Jehu and put to death. They buried him, for they said, “He is the grandson of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart.” So no one was left from the house of Ahaziah with the strength to rule the kingdom.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander anointed by God to destroy the house of Ahab.
Jehu searched for Ahaziah.
Ahaziah was the king of Judah.
Jehu’s men found Ahaziah hiding in Samaria.
They captured Ahaziah.
They brought Ahaziah to Jehu.
Jehu’s men killed Ahaziah.
They buried Ahaziah.
They said, “Ahaziah is the grandson of Jehoshaphat.”
Jehoshaphat had sought the LORD with all his heart.
No one from Ahaziah’s family had the strength to rule the kingdom.
passages.original: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ֩ אֶת־ אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ וַֽיִּלְכְּדֻ֜הוּ וְה֧וּא מִתְחַבֵּ֣א בְשֹֽׁמְר֗וֹן וַיְבִאֻ֣הוּ אֶל־ יֵהוּא֮ וַיְמִתֻהוּ֒ וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֔הוּ כִּ֤י אָֽמְרוּ֙ בֶּן־ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁר־ דָּרַ֥שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּכָל־ לְבָב֑וֹ וְאֵין֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ לַעְצֹ֥ר כֹּ֖חַ לְמַמְלָכָֽה׃

passages.text: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to annihilate all the royal heirs of the house of Judah.
passages.sermon:
Athaliah was the mother of Ahaziah.
Athaliah saw that her son Ahaziah was dead.
Athaliah acted immediately.
Athaliah set out to destroy all the royal heirs of the house of Judah.
passages.original: וַעֲתַלְיָ֙הוּ֙ אֵ֣ם אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ רָאֲתָ֖ה כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת בְּנָ֑הּ וַתָּ֗קָם וַתְּדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־ כָּל־ זֶ֥רַע הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה לְבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: But Jehoshabeath daughter of King Jehoram took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the sons of the king who were being murdered, and she put him and his nurse in a bedroom. Because Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram and the wife of Jehoiada the priest, was Ahaziah’s sister, she hid Joash from Athaliah so that she could not kill him.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshabeath was the daughter of King Jehoram.
She was also the wife of Jehoiada the priest.
Jehoshabeath was the sister of Ahaziah.
Joash was the son of Ahaziah.
Athaliah wanted to kill all the royal children.
Jehoshabeath took Joash away from the other sons of the king who were being killed.
She stole Joash from among the children who were about to die.
She put Joash and his nurse in a bedroom.
Jehoshabeath hid Joash from Athaliah.
Athaliah could not kill Joash because he was hidden.
passages.original: וַתִּקַּח֩ יְהוֹשַׁבְעַ֨ת בַּת־ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־ יוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן־ אֲחַזְיָ֗הוּ וַתִּגְנֹ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ מִתּ֤וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַמּ֣וּמָתִ֔ים וַתִּתֵּ֥ן אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־ מֵֽינִקְתּ֖וֹ בַּחֲדַ֣ר הַמִּטּ֑וֹת וַתַּסְתִּירֵ֡הוּ יְהוֹשַׁבְעַ֣ת בַּת־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹרָ֡ם אֵשֶׁת֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַכֹּהֵ֜ן כִּ֣י הִיא֩ הָיְתָ֨ה אֲח֧וֹת אֲחַזְיָ֛הוּ מִפְּנֵ֥י עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ וְלֹ֥א הֱמִיתָֽתְהוּ׃

passages.text: And Joash remained hidden with them in the house of God for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.
passages.sermon:
Joash was a young boy from the royal family of Judah.
Athaliah was the queen who ruled the land.
Jehoshabeath, Joash’s aunt, hid Joash and his nurse.
They stayed in the house of God.
Joash remained hidden there for six years.
During those six years, Athaliah ruled over the land.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֤י אִתָּם֙ בְּבֵ֣ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים מִתְחַבֵּ֖א שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וַעֲתַלְיָ֖ה מֹלֶ֥כֶת עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ
